Source.// Kind: Oracle | Replay. Oracle is the production path and reads what Crm04.Feeder writes. Replay reads the exported simulator dataset straight from disk, so the stack runs with no database at all.

Oracle.// StartAtLatest: Begin at the newest frame rather than replaying history a 10 Hz UI could never catch up from.
Oracle.// CatchUpThreshold: If more frames than this are pending, publish only the newest. The API holds one MachineState, not a queue.

Replay.// Directory: Defaults to dotnet/data/replay. Generate it with: npx tsx scripts/exportSimFrames.ts --minutes 30
Replay.// Mode: SIMULATION | SIM_46TAG | LIVE. Same numbers, different honesty. SIM_46TAG and LIVE show the provenance the values will carry on the real CRM04 feed - force ESTIMATED, roll gap CALCULATED, bending and hydraulics NO TAG.
